title_zh: 不一样的卡梅拉3-我想有个弟弟
title_en: Carmela the Different 3 - I Want a Little Brother
source_file: 不一样的卡梅拉3-我想有个弟弟.ppt
full_text_zh:
[P1] 不一样的卡梅拉3
亚马逊网站五星级童书
★★★★★
我想有个弟弟
[法]克利斯提昂·约里波瓦/文
[法]克利斯提昂·艾利施/图
郑迪蔚 游然/译
小红狐童书

[P2] 孵小鸡的时候，是全鸡舍最盛
大的节日。
看到一只只毛茸茸的小宝贝破
壳而出，鸡爸爸、鸡妈妈们高兴得眉
开眼笑，他们给宝贝们喂好吃的，又
是抱，又是扛、又是逗他们开心……
忙得不亦乐乎，小宝贝们趁机撒娇、
耍赖、哭闹……到处洋溢着幸福和
欢乐。
只有卡梅利多独自在一旁发愣，
他感到郁闷、孤独：“为什么我没有
一个小弟弟呢？”

[P3] “如果我有一个小弟弟，我们就可以一起玩骑山羊、捉迷藏的游戏，可惜……”

“嗨，科西斯，你能把你的小弟弟借给我玩一会儿吗？”
“哦，不行！怎么可能？这是我的小弟弟！”

卡梅利多遭到了拒绝，他失望地大喊：
“我也要一个小弟弟！”

[P4] “妈妈！爸爸！怎样才能生个孩子？”
妈妈亲切地抱着卡梅利多，跟他解释这个生命的大秘密。
“你知道吗，宝贝儿，每一个鸡妈妈都要用三个
星期的时间，才能把小鸡从蛋里孵出来……”
“但是，农场主拿走了我们所有的蛋，因为你妈妈
产的蛋是全鸡舍里最好的！所以，连孵化一只鸡蛋的机
会都没有！”
卡梅利多很伤心，他知道，他永远也不会有小弟弟了。

[P5] 好心的鸬鹚佩罗非常同情他们的遭遇：“朋友们，把鸡蛋交给我来孵化吧！农场主做梦也不会想到，我的木桶里会有你们的蛋！

“真的！亲爱的佩罗，你不仅善良，还非常聪明，多妙的主意！
“一个无人知晓的鸡蛋。”
“一只地下‘黑’鸡。”
“一个秘密的小弟弟。”

瞅，谢谢你，佩罗！

[P6] 从这天开始，佩罗就在自己的桶里孵化卡梅拉的鸡蛋，尽管农场主的老婆常常从这里经过，但她连正眼都没有看过木桶。孵小鸡需要阳光，这个笨女人什么都不懂，佩罗只好冲她大叫：
“嘿，走开点，别挡了我的阳光，讨厌鬼！”
每天晚上，卡梅丽多都要悄悄离开鸡舍，跑来敲佩罗的木桶。“鸠——鸠！佩罗？我能看看我的小弟弟吗？”

[P7] “你好，小弟弟！”
卡梅利多轻轻走进佩罗温暖的木桶，低声问候。
鸡蛋里的小鸡，踢了蛋壳一脚算是回答。
“喂！小弟弟，你要是能早一点出来多好呀！”

鸬鹚佩罗把鸡蛋放在烛光前一照，奇迹出现了！卡梅利多看到了蛋壳里小弟弟的轮廓，他还没长毛呢。
“啊，我的小弟弟！”他高兴得嘴都闭不上了。

[P8] 伟大的一天终于到来了。
蛋壳里的小鸡很快就要蹦出来了！
如果是一个男孩，就叫尚特。
如果是一个女孩，就叫卡门。
在小伙伴贝里奥的陪伴下，卡梅利多
忙了起来，他满心欢喜地要亲手给小弟弟
做一件礼物：一根非常漂亮的木棍。

[P9] 不远处，两只饥饿的刺猬，正贼眉鼠眼地想找点食物来填饱肚子。
他们想，今天一定要吃顿大餐才过瘾。
“哇，好香的苹果！”
“傻瓜，这是人类设下的陷阱！”
小刺猬的肚子饿得咕咕直叫。哥哥拉着她，向附近的鸡舍跑去。
“我们到鸡舍转转，没准儿能找到点什么。”

[P10] 鸡舍边，佩罗正向朋友们表演精彩的耍棍绝技，
“怎么样，佩服吧，小伙子们！”
“太棒啦！……”
突然，卡梅利多发现，两只刺猬正抛着玩的
是……
“我的小弟弟！快看！
他们偷了我的小弟弟！！！"

[P11] 卡梅利多愤怒地拿起棍子，立即追了出去。
“我抄近路，从田地过去！”贝里奥喊道。
“我从森林过去，拦住他们……”
“要小心！刺猬很狡猾的。”佩罗一再叮嘱。

[P12] “尼克！再传过来！”
“接住！皮克，哈哈！”
“皮克！”
“尼克！”
“给我！皮克！”
“不，我先拿到的！”

[P13] 壳里的小鸡提出了抗议。
咯！咯！
咯！咯！
咯！咯！
咯！咯！
咯！咯！
咯！咯！
咯！咯！
“啊！一个会说话的鸡蛋！！！”
“小心，尼克！这个蛋肯定是个怪物！”

[P14] 嘭！
当卡梅利多举着棍子赶到时，两只
刺猬已经跑远。
“我的小弟弟！……”
“天哪！她是——一个女孩！”
咯、咯！
“算了吧，有个妹妹也不错！我应该高兴才是！”

[P15] “放下木棍，卡门！这可不是给一个小姑娘的玩具。”
咯、咯！
哎哟！
“好吧，拿好了你的木棍。”
“我们只有渡过这条河才能回到家，来，跟我做！”

[P16] 咔嚓！
咯、咯！
“你……”
“咯咯、咯咯！”
“你饿了？好吧，跟我来，我找找看有什么吃的。”
“看！这儿有一个苹果正等我们呢！卡门，你喜欢吃苹果吗？”

[P17] 呼！
陷阱套住了这个冒失鬼。
卡门还以为哥哥在开玩笑。
咯、咯！
不过，她很快就明白了哥哥需要帮助。她找来一个大松果，垫在木棍下面，用力一撬。
“卡门！……”卡梅利多的话还没说完，笼子已被卡门撬开了。
“卡门，你真了不起！”
咯！

[P18] 贝里奥一直没有看到卡梅利多的影子……
“夫人？你有没有看到一只粉色的小鸡，他在追一个鸡蛋？”
“一只很可爱的小鸡？和一个比他还小的鸡蛋？”
“卡梅利多——！！！”
在森林里，卡门发现一块面包屑……
接着又有一块……还有一块……
“你在吃什么？”
咯、咯！

[P20] 卡门和卡梅利多找到了回家的路，在一条小径的转弯处……
“偷我妹妹的小偷！！！”
咯！
“从里面出来！再不出来，小心我拿石头砸烂你们的头……”
卡门可没有忘记皮克和尼克，刚才是怎样捣乱自己的。对这两个讨厌的家伙，卡门想出了一种新游戏。
咯、咯！

[P21] 噢，噢，啊！

“这个声音怎么这么熟悉……”

咯！

“贝里奥！”

“我的好伙伴！”

卡梅利多滔滔不绝地讲着他的妹妹：
“……贝里奥！你简直无法想象她有多棒！她既勇敢，又聪明，只是还不会说话……”

[P22] “哦！我们最小的宝贝回来啦！”
皮迪克深情地看着妻子：“她长得真像你呀，亲爱的。”
这里面最高兴的，当然是卡梅利多。
他有了一个这么可爱的小妹妹！
他们形影不离：骑山羊，划小船……
卡梅利多还一遍遍地给妹妹唱歌：
小鸡小鸡叽叽叽，
跟着哥哥去啄米。
看到天上老鹰飞，
躲进哥哥翅膀里。
……
咯、咯！

[P23] 一天早上，农场主的老婆吃惊地在卡门前站住了：“咦？我怎么从来没见过你，小东西！你是从哪儿来的？
“嘿，走开点，
别挡了我的阳光，
讨厌鬼！”

[P24] “她会说话了！！！”
full_text_en:
[P1] Different Chicken Camille 3
Amazon's Five-Star Children's Book
★★★★★
I Want a Little Brother
[France] Christian Jolibois / Text
[France] Christian Heinrich / Illustrations
Zheng Difei, You Ran / Translators
Little Red Fox Children's Books

[P2] When chicks hatch, it's the biggest holiday in the whole chicken coop.
Seeing fluffy little babies break out of their shells, the chicken dads and moms are overjoyed, beaming with happiness. They feed them delicious food, carry them, hug them, and play with them... busy as ever. The little babies take the chance to be cute, act spoiled, and cry... happiness and joy fill the air everywhere.
Only Camille is sitting alone, looking lost in thought. He feels gloomy and lonely: "Why don't I have a little brother?"

[P3] "If only I had a little brother, we could play riding goats and hide-and-seek together, but alas..."

"Hey, César, could you lend me your little brother to play with for a while?"
"Oh, no way! How could you? He's my little brother!"

Camille was rejected and cried out in disappointment:
"I want a little brother too!"

[P4] "Mom! Dad! How can you have a baby?"
Mom lovingly hugged Camille, explaining the big secret of life to him.
"You know, sweetie, every chicken mom needs three
weeks to hatch a chick from an egg..."
"But the farmer took all our eggs, because your mom's
eggs are the best in the whole coop! So, there's not even a chance
to hatch a single egg!"
Camille was very sad. He knew he would never have a little brother.

[P5] The kind-hearted cormorant Pero felt deeply sympathetic for their plight: "Friends, give me your eggs to hatch! The farm owner would never dream that your eggs would be in my barrel!"

"Really! Dear Pero, you're not only kind, but also very clever—what a brilliant idea!"
"An egg no one knows about."
"A 'black' chicken underground."
"A secret little brother."

"Look, thank you, Pero!"

[P6] From this day on, Perro incubated Camilla's eggs in his own barrel. Even though the farm owner's wife often passed by, she never even glanced at the barrel. Chicks need sunlight, and this silly woman didn't understand a thing. So Perro shouted at her:
"Hey, move aside, you're blocking my sunlight, you nuisance!"
Every evening, Camille would sneak away from the henhouse and come to knock on Perro's barrel. "Coo—coo! Perro? Can I see my little brother?"

[P7] "Hello, little brother!"
Caramelito gently walked into Perro's warm barrel and greeted softly.
The chick inside the egg kicked the shell once as a reply.
"Hey! Little brother, it would be so great if you could come out a bit earlier!"

The cormorant Perro held the egg up to the candlelight, and a miracle appeared! Caramelito saw the outline of his little brother inside the shell—he hadn't grown any feathers yet.
"Ah, my little brother!" He was so happy he couldn't close his mouth.

[P8] The great day has finally arrived.
The chick inside the egg is about to hatch!
If it's a boy, he'll be called Chant.
If it's a girl, she'll be called Carmen.
With his friend Bélier by his side, Camille
busied himself, happily preparing a gift for his little brother:
a very beautiful stick.

[P9] Not far away, two hungry hedgehogs were sneaking around, looking for something to eat to fill their stomachs.
They thought, today they must have a big meal to satisfy themselves.
"Wow, such delicious apples!"
"Fool, this is a trap set by humans!"
The little hedgehog's stomach growled. The older brother pulled her toward the nearby chicken coop.
"Let's check around the chicken coop; maybe we can find something."

[P10] By the chicken coop, Pero was performing his amazing stick-juggling skills to his friends.
"How about that, impressed, guys?"
"Awesome! ..."
Suddenly, Camille discovered that the two hedgehogs were tossing around...
"My little brother! Look!
They stole my little brother!!!"

[P11] Camille angrily picked up the stick and immediately ran out.
"I'll take the shortcut through the fields!" Berio shouted.
"I'll go through the forest and block them..."
"Be careful! Hedgehogs are very cunning," Perro warned repeatedly.

[P12] "Nick! Pass it over again!"
"Catch it! Pick, haha!"
"Pick!"
"Nick!"
"Give it to me! Pick!"
"No, I got it first!"

[P13] The chicks inside the shells protested.
Cluck! Cluck!
Cluck! Cluck!
Cluck! Cluck!
Cluck! Cluck!
Cluck! Cluck!
Cluck! Cluck!
Cluck! Cluck!
"Ah! A talking egg!!!"
"Be careful, Nick! This egg must be a monster!"

[P14] Peng!
When Camille held the stick and arrived, the two
hedgehogs had already run away.
“My little brother! ...”
“Oh my! She’s —— a girl!”
Cluck, cluck!
“Well, having a little sister is fine too! I should be happy!”

[P15] "Put down the stick, Carmen! This isn't a toy for a little girl."
Cluck, cluck!
Ouch!
"Alright, hold onto your stick."
"We can only get home by crossing this river. Come on, follow me!"

[P16] Crack!
Cock-a-doodle-doo!
"You..."
"Cock-a-doodle-doo, cock-a-doodle-doo!"
"You're hungry? Alright, come with me, I'll look for something to eat."
"Look! There's an apple waiting for us here! Carmen, do you like apples?"

[P17] Whoosh!
A trap caught this clumsy fellow.
Carmen thought her brother was joking.
Cluck, cluck!
But she quickly realized her brother needed help. She found a big pinecone, placed it under the stick, and pried hard.
"Carmen! ..." Camembert hadn't finished speaking when the cage was already pried open by Carmen.
"Carmen, you're amazing!"
Cluck!

[P18] Bélier hasn't seen Camélidon's shadow at all...
"Madam? Have you seen a pink little chick chasing an egg?"
"A very cute little chick? And an egg smaller than him?"
"Camélidon——!!!"
In the forest, Carmen found a crumb of bread...
Then another... and another...
"What are you eating?"
Cluck, cluck!

[P20] Carmen and Camille found the way home, at a bend in a little path...
"Thief who stole my sister!!!"
Clack!
"Come out from inside! If you don't come out, I'll smash your heads with stones..."
Carmen hadn't forgotten how Pick and Nick had just been causing trouble for her. For these two annoying fellows, Carmen came up with a new game.
Clack, clack!

[P21] Oh, oh, ah!

"This voice sounds so familiar..."

Cluck!

"Bélier!"

"My good friend!"

Camille spoke enthusiastically about his sister:
"...Bélier! You can't imagine how wonderful she is! She's brave and smart, just can't talk yet..."

[P22] "Oh! Our littlest baby is back!"
Pidik looked lovingly at his wife: "She looks just like you, dear."
Of course, the happiest one here was Camilodo.
He had such a cute little sister!
They were inseparable: riding goats, rowing little boats...
Camilodo sang to his sister over and over:
Little chick, little chick, cheep cheep cheep,
Following brother to peck rice.
When seeing eagles flying in the sky,
Hide under brother's wings.
...
Cluck, cluck!

[P23] One morning, the farm owner's wife stood in front of Carmen, surprised: "Huh? I've never seen you before, little thing! Where did you come from?"
"Hey, get out of the way, 
stop blocking my sunshine, 
annoying pest!"

[P24] "She can talk!!!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《我想有个弟弟》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者信息，以及一只红色小鸡在木桶巢穴中抱着蛋，旁边有大鸟和石墙背景的插图。
[P2] 本页描绘了鸡舍里小鸡孵化的热闹场景，鸡爸爸鸡妈妈和小鸡们其乐融融，而卡梅利多独自在一旁感到郁闷和孤独，心想为什么自己没有一个小弟弟。
[P3] 卡梅利多向科西斯借弟弟玩，遭到拒绝后，他感到失望并大声喊出自己也想要一个小弟弟。
[P4] 卡梅利多向父母询问如何生孩子，妈妈解释了孵化小鸡的过程，但爸爸指出农场主拿走了所有鸡蛋，导致卡梅利多永远无法拥有弟弟，他因此感到伤心。
[P5] 鸬鹚佩罗主动提出帮忙孵化鸡蛋，鸡妈妈们感激并称赞他的聪明主意，称这将是一个秘密的小弟弟。
[P6] 佩罗在木桶里孵化卡梅拉的鸡蛋，因农场主老婆挡光而生气驱赶；卡梅丽多每晚悄悄前来敲桶，询问能否看看自己的小弟弟。
[P7] 卡梅利多悄悄来到佩罗的木桶前，向蛋中的小鸡问好，小鸡用踢蛋壳回应。佩罗用烛光照射鸡蛋，卡梅利多看到了小弟弟的轮廓，兴奋不已。
[P8] 小鸡即将孵化，卡梅利多在小伙伴贝里奥的陪伴下，满心欢喜地为即将到来的小弟弟准备礼物——一根漂亮的木棍。
[P9] 两只饥饿的刺猬在森林里寻找食物，发现一个装有苹果的笼子，误以为是美味大餐，但哥哥识破这是人类设下的陷阱，于是他们决定前往鸡舍寻找食物。
[P10] 佩罗在鸡舍边表演耍棍绝技，卡梅利多和朋友们在一旁观看。突然，卡梅利多发现两只刺猬正在玩弄一个蛋，惊呼那是自己的小弟弟，以为小弟弟被偷走了。
[P11] 卡梅利多发现刺猬在玩弄他的小弟弟的蛋，愤怒地拿起棍子追了出去，贝里奥和佩罗分别从田地和森林赶去帮忙，并提醒要小心狡猾的刺猬。
[P12] 两只刺猬在森林里玩一个蛋，互相传递并争抢，以为是游戏中的道具。
[P13] 壳里的小鸡因被刺猬玩弄而发出抗议声，刺猬们惊呼蛋会说话，并认为它是个怪物，感到害怕。
[P14] 小鸡从蛋中孵化出来，两只刺猬惊慌逃走。卡梅利多赶到后发现是个妹妹，起初惊讶，随后表示接受并感到高兴。
[P15] 卡梅利多和卡门在河边，卡门想用木棍玩耍，卡梅利多阻止并教导她，随后带领她学习如何渡河回家。
[P16] 卡梅利多和卡门在河边，卡梅利多用木棍击打水面，卡门模仿他，随后卡梅利多带卡门去找食物，在森林里发现一个苹果，并询问卡门是否喜欢。
[P17] 卡门发现哥哥被陷阱困住，起初以为他在开玩笑，后来明白需要帮忙，便用松果和木棍撬开了笼子，成功救出哥哥，哥哥称赞她了不起。
[P18] 贝里奥在寻找卡梅利多，向夫人询问是否见过一只粉色小鸡追鸡蛋，随后在森林里，卡门发现面包屑并好奇地吃起来，发出咯咯声。
[P19] 画面分为三格，描绘了森林中的场景：第一格，一个小男孩在奔跑，身后跟着两只小鸡；第二格，小男孩在树丛间穿行；第三格，一群穿着兽皮的人在树后窥视，小男孩继续向前跑，地上有面包屑。
[P20] 卡门和卡梅利多在回家的路上遇到刺猬皮克和尼克，卡门认出他们曾欺负自己，便用木棍教训他们，发泄怒气。
[P21] 卡梅利多和卡门在森林中遇到贝里奥，卡梅利多兴奋地向贝里奥介绍自己的妹妹卡门，称赞她勇敢聪明，但还不会说话。
[P22] 卡梅利多和卡门回到鸡群中，受到大家欢迎，皮迪克称赞卡门像妻子。卡梅利多非常高兴，为妹妹唱歌，表达对她的喜爱和保护。
[P23] 农场主的妻子在卡门前发现了一只从未见过的小鸡，惊讶地询问它的来历，而小鸡则不耐烦地让她走开，别挡阳光。
[P24] 鸡群中的一只小鸡突然开口说话，其他鸡和公鸡都感到非常惊讶和兴奋。
